footer.notice: Built for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon · Powered by Muse Spark, SAM 3.1 and Muse Image.

models.title: Settings
models.lead: Three Meta models power every ad. Add your key once and you are ready.
models.sectionNote: Each model has one fixed job, so there is nothing to choose.
models.spark: Reads the product photo, extracts your brand, writes ideas and copy in your dialect, and reviews every finished ad.
models.image: Paints the finished ad from your mockup, enhances phone photos, and creates variants and seasonal themes.
models.sam: Cuts the product out of its photo, guided by a box from Muse Spark or a tap from you.
models.testNote: A test sends one small request with your key and may be billed. It never blocks a feature.
models.keyLead: Stays in this tab's memory. Optional encrypted saving is below.

gallery.title: My gallery
gallery.lead: Every finished ad is saved here on this device. Make variants or a seasonal copy from any of them.
gallery.deleteFailed: Could not delete the saved ad.
gallery.loadFailed: Could not read the gallery from this browser.
gallery.emptyLead: Your finished ads appear here automatically.

oneshot.agentCutBox: Cut from the Muse Spark box
oneshot.attemptsNote: The critic scored the first try low, so its notes went back to Muse Image for one more attempt. The higher score is shown; you can switch.
oneshot.needCanvas: Wait a moment for the canvas to finish loading.
oneshot.draftRestored: Your last ad was restored from this device.
oneshot.stepProductLead: Upload a phone photo of your product, then cut it out with SAM. If the cutout misses, tap the product.
oneshot.stepBrandLead: Pick a saved brand, or write a name and description. Muse Spark can read them from your product.
oneshot.stepIdeaLead: Get three ideas from Muse Spark, or write the scene yourself.
oneshot.certJudgment: Muse Spark compared the finished ad with your mockup. The score is a model judgment.
oneshot.trustLead: Everything below was measured on this device. Nothing here is sent anywhere.
oneshot.trustCertValid: Certificate: valid for this exact mockup.
oneshot.trustCertCleared: Certificate: cleared because the mockup changed after review.
oneshot.dialectPreview: Tone example (a fixed sample, not generated):

home.title: From a phone photo to an Instagram ad in a minute, in your dialect.
home.lead: Snap your product, pick your brand, and AdMorph cuts it out, writes the copy and paints a finished ad — then checks it matches what you arranged.
home.sampleNote: Sample: the “after” image is a layout made with AdMorph’s local editor, not a Muse Image output.
home.role_image: The painter — paints the finished ad
home.how1: Upload a phone photo. SAM cuts the product out.
home.how2: Pick your brand and an idea in your dialect.
home.how3: Arrange it, then Muse Image paints the ad and Muse Spark checks it.
home.emptyLead: Every ad you finish is saved on this device and shown here.
